title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on today's biggest Israeli sports stories, from European qualifiers to an NBA coaching hire.

questions.question: Who scored the only goal as Beitar Jerusalem beat AEK Larnaca 1-0 away in the Conference League qualifier?
questions.explanation: Colombian centre-back Brayan Carabalí struck a direct free-kick in the 77th minute to sink ten-man Larnaca.

questions.question: Issouf Sissokho scored his first-ever goal for Maccabi Tel Aviv in the 5-0 rout of Sheriff Tiraspol. Which club did he join Maccabi from?
questions.explanation: Sissokho joined Maccabi Tel Aviv from Bordeaux in August 2024 and finally opened his account in the 78th minute in Tiraspol.

questions.question: Who was hired as Portland's head coach in late June 2026 after five seasons as Minnesota's lead assistant?
questions.explanation: Micah Nori, 52, was promoted from Chris Finch's staff in Minnesota, and analysts say his success hinges on Deni Avdija's development.

questions.question: Which club does Oscar Gloukh play for after scoring in a 4-1 Conference League win over FK Vojvodina?
questions.explanation: Gloukh, who joined Ajax from Red Bull Salzburg in August 2025, netted Ajax's third goal in Novi Sad, assisted by Mika Godts.

questions.question: Anan Khalaili's reported €23m move to Inter Milan collapsed after he failed a medical screening required by which body?
questions.explanation: CONI's fitness screening blocked his Italian registration, though he remains free to keep playing for Union Saint-Gilloise in Belgium.
